description: This file defines a dependency injection module for database-related components in an Android project. It configures Room database builder, specifies migrations, and provides DAO instances via the Koin library.

classes.name: DatabaseModule
classes.description: Contains a Koin module for providing database and DAO instances.

methods.name: dbModule
methods.description: Defines a Koin module that provides a singleton AppDatabase instance configured with migrations, and singleton DAO instances.
